span.div:
Access pattern: 95% reads, 5% writes → readers-writer lock
Access pattern: all writes to same key → single lock
Access pattern: writes to random keys → per-key lock
Contention level: > 10% contention → coarser locks
Critical section: < 1ms → fine-grained overhead acceptable
Critical section: > 100ms → coarser locks reduce overhead
